sloka: आकाशात् अपतत् राम शिवे शिव शिरस्य् उत ।अचिन्तयः च सा देवी गंग परम दुर्धरा ॥१-४३-५॥
transliteration: ākāśāt apatat rāma śive śiva śirasy uta ।acintayaḥ ca sā devī gaṁga parama durdharā ॥1-43-5॥

translations.english: "Goddess Ganga, extremely difficult to contain, thought that seizing Siva with her flow she would enter the lower regions of the earth.
